vellum_obligation: The canvas kernel must cache laid-out paragraphs across per-frame canvases under a key that holds every input the paragraph build reads (text, resolved family stack, primary typeface, size, weight, slant, letter spacing, direction, hinting, OpenType features and the font-registration generation), with float fields made canonical (non-finite replaced, -0 folded to +0) so equal keys hash equally; it must be bounded by entries and bytes, keep entries looked up more than once ahead of single-use text when evicting, destroy evicted entries outside its lock, and drop every entry on font registration. The paint must not be part of the key and must be applied at draw time, never by updating a cached paragraph's foreground paint, and a cached draw must be pixel-identical to an uncached one.
